//.about: Copy this file OUTSIDE Git, fill in the keys you need, point AR_CREATE_CONFIG (or --config) at it. Every path below is an invented example. Remove this '//' block if you like; it is ignored.
//.home: Installed home only. Absolute path of the permanent home; serve.mjs must live at <home>/service/serve.mjs. Leave null for the demo or a candidate checkout.
//.dataDir: Absolute directory for saved work. Must be outside the checkout and, unless allowScratchRoots is true, not under ~/.codex, /tmp, /private/tmp or /private/var/folders. Env AR_CREATE_DATA_DIR / --data-dir override it.
//.port: Env AR_CREATE_PORT / --port override it. 8841 is refused unless 'home' is set and dataDir is <home>/data.
//.allowScratchRoots: Tests and the disposable demo only. Lets dataDir and the transcript roots sit under a scratch folder.
//.syntheticFixtures: true shows the invented demo projects. Leave false for real work.
//.fixturesDir: Folder holding a private replacement for synthetic-study-data.js. Served only to loopback. Null = none.
//.relocationFile: Installed home only. Exact owner/root relocation proof JSON produced by the integrator.
//.studyOriginalRoots: Read-only original roots. catalog.projects maps a project key to {title, docs:[[path,label]], audio:[], relatedProjects:[]}; catalog.drafts maps a draft id to {parentStudyKey, partKey, title, path, contextScope, support:[[path,label]]}. Paths are relative to vaultRoot.
//.originalReaderBaseUrl: http(s) base URL of a reader for originals, or null.
//.editorialSkillsDir: Folder with arcreate/ and mag/ skill files. Null = none.
//.editorialSkills: Optional explicit skill file paths. Derived from editorialSkillsDir when empty.
//.magazine: {vaultRoot}: the Magazine folder holding TEMPLATE.md and SYSTEM.md. Null = none.
//.tools: Absolute paths of host tools. Null = that capability is off. python = interpreter; transcriptionVenv = a virtualenv folder whose bin/python is used when python is null.
//.transcriptLibrary: {registryFile, indexFile, libraryRoot}, all absolute, or null.
